user.title: Set up DJConnect
user.description: Start with the route that matches your setup. Use the Assist agent without a physical device, choose local device for ESP32/Raspberry Pi on your network, or choose app for iPhone/iPad, Apple Watch, macOS and Windows.

pair.title: Pair DJConnect Device
pair.description: Pair a DJConnect client with Home Assistant.

data_description.pair_code: The 6 digit pairing code shown on the device display.
data_description.device_name: Friendly name for this DJConnect remote.
data_description.local_url: Local device API fallback; leave empty when mDNS works.
data_description.discovered_client: Choose an automatically discovered DJConnect client to prefill pairing details, or use manual entry.
data_description.app_pair_code: Use this code in macOS/Windows, or let iPhone/iPad/Apple Watch receive it from the QR/deep-link payload.
data_description.app_ha_local_url: Local Home Assistant URL the app uses during pairing.
data_description.app_iphone_pairing_uri: QR/deep-link payload for the iPhone/iPad app.
data_description.app_watch_pairing_uri: QR/deep-link payload scanned on iPhone/iPad to pair the linked Apple Watch.

pair_type.title: Choose Client Type
pair_type.description: First choose which DJConnect client type you want to pair.

data_description.client_type: DJConnect uses this to show only the relevant pairing fields.

pair_local_device_type.title: Choose Local Device
pair_local_device_type.description: Choose which local DJConnect device you want to pair.

pair_local_device_details.description: Enter the pairing details for this local device.

data_description.pair_code: The 6 digit pairing code shown on the DJConnect device.

data_description.discovered_client: Choose an automatically discovered ESP32/Raspberry Pi client to prefill pairing details, or use manual entry.

pair_local_device.title: Pair Local Device
pair_local_device.description: Use this route for ESP32 and Raspberry Pi clients on your local network. Choose a discovered device or enter the pairing code shown on the display. Client address is only needed when mDNS does not work.

data_description.device_name: Friendly name for this local device.

data_description.discovered_client: Choose an automatically discovered ESP32/Raspberry Pi client to prefill pairing details, or use manual entry.

pair_app.title: Pair App
pair_app.description:
Use this route for iPhone/iPad, Apple Watch, macOS and Windows.

**iPhone/iPad**

![iPhone/iPad QR code]({iphone_qr_image})

**Apple Watch**

![Apple Watch QR code]({watch_qr_image})

macOS and Windows use the Home Assistant URL and pairing code below.

data_description.device_name: Friendly name for this app installation.
data_description.client_type: Choose iPhone/iPad, Apple Watch, macOS or Windows.
data_description.app_pair_code: Use this code in macOS/Windows, or let iPhone/iPad/Apple Watch receive it from the QR/deep-link payload.
data_description.app_ha_local_url: Local Home Assistant URL the app uses during pairing.
data_description.app_iphone_pairing_uri: QR/deep-link payload for the iPhone/iPad app.
data_description.app_watch_pairing_uri: QR/deep-link payload scanned on iPhone/iPad to pair the linked Apple Watch.

pair_app_type.title: Choose App
pair_app_type.description: Choose which DJConnect app type you want to pair.

pair_app_ios_details.title: Pair DJConnect iPhone/iPad App
pair_app_ios_details.description:
Scan this QR code with the iPhone/iPad app.

![iPhone/iPad QR code]({iphone_qr_image})

If the QR code is not visible, enter these values in the app:

- Home Assistant URL: `{ha_local_url}`
- Pairing code: `{pair_code}`

data_description.app_pair_code: Use this code if the QR code is not visible.
data_description.app_ha_local_url: Local Home Assistant URL for app pairing.
data_description.device_name: Friendly name for this iPhone/iPad app installation.

pair_app_watch_details.title: Pair DJConnect Apple Watch App
pair_app_watch_details.description:
Scan this Watch QR code on iPhone/iPad to pair the linked Apple Watch.

![Apple Watch QR code]({watch_qr_image})

If the QR code is not visible, enter these values in the app:

- Home Assistant URL: `{ha_local_url}`
- Pairing code: `{pair_code}`

data_description.app_pair_code: Use this code if the QR code is not visible.
data_description.app_ha_local_url: Local Home Assistant URL for app pairing.
data_description.device_name: Friendly name for this Apple Watch app installation.

ble_wifi.title: Configure ESP32 device WiFi (over Bluetooth)
ble_wifi.description: Select a DJConnect device in setup mode to write WiFi over BLE, or continue to pairing if WiFi was already configured through the captive portal.

data_description.ble_address: Bluetooth address of the DJConnect setup device.
data_description.wifi_ssid: WiFi network name to save on the DJConnect device.
data_description.wifi_password: WiFi password. This is sent only to the BLE WiFi characteristic and is not logged.
data_description.ble_action: Choose one action: write WiFi over Bluetooth, rescan devices or continue directly to pairing.

spotify.title: Connect Spotify
spotify.description: Create your own Spotify Developer app at {developer_url} and register this exact redirect URI: `{redirect_uri}`. Prefer your Nabu Casa HTTPS Home Assistant URL. DJConnect uses PKCE, so no Client Secret is needed.

data_description.spotify_client_id: Client ID from your own Spotify Developer app.
data_description.ha_external_url: External Home Assistant URL Spotify returns to after authorization.

spotify_oauth.title: Authorize DJConnect with Spotify
spotify_oauth.description: Home Assistant opens Spotify in your browser. After approving access, return here to continue setup.

data_description.assist_pipeline_id: Assist pipeline used by DJConnect devices for speech recognition and DJ announcement audio.
data_description.client_type: DJConnect client type: app, local device or Assist agent.
data_description.firmware_channel: Choose stable for normal OTA updates or beta to test prerelease firmware.
data_description.voice_profile: Choose the fallback DJConnect radio style. When a client sends mood, that mood automatically selects the voice profile; the Home Assistant TTS voice still determines the actual audio voice.

spotify_reauth.title: Reauthorize Spotify
spotify_reauth.description: Home Assistant opens Spotify so DJConnect can be authorized again. After approval you return to Home Assistant.

spotify_reauth_done.title: Spotify OAuth succeeded
spotify_reauth_done.description: DJConnect Spotify OAuth succeeded. You can close this window; Home Assistant now manages Spotify playback itself.

repair_pairing.title: Re-pair DJConnect
repair_pairing.description: Put the DJConnect device in pairing mode and enter the new pairing code shown on its display. Home Assistant will create a new device token.

data_description.pair_code: The 6 digit pairing code shown on the device display.
data_description.local_url: Only for ESP32/Raspberry Pi local device API fallback; leave empty to reuse the stored URL.

central_api.title: DJConnect API token
central_api.description: Advanced support only. DJConnect normally creates the per-install token automatically under the hood; the token is secret and used only for this Home Assistant installation.

data_description.api_base_url: Central DJConnect API base URL. Keep the default unless DJConnect support tells you otherwise.
data_description.ha_install_id: Stable ID for this Home Assistant installation. It is generated locally and cannot be edited here.
data_description.djconnect_install_token: Secret per-install token. DJConnect normally fills this automatically; never paste this token in issues or logs.
data_description.options_action: Save support settings, or rotate the token through the central DJConnect API.

backend.title: Music backend
backend.description: Choose the backend DJConnect uses for playback. Spotify Direct uses DJConnect Spotify OAuth. Music Assistant uses your Home Assistant Music Assistant setup and does not require a Spotify Client ID in DJConnect.

data_description.music_backend: Choose Spotify Direct or Music Assistant. Spotify is a trademark of Spotify AB. DJConnect is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Spotify AB.

music_assistant.title: Music Assistant player
music_assistant.description: Choose the Music Assistant player DJConnect should control. Music Assistant must already be installed and configured in Home Assistant.

data_description.music_assistant_player: The Home Assistant media_player entity exposed by Music Assistant.

error.missing_pair_code: Enter the pairing code shown on the DJConnect device display.

error.ble_device_required: Select a DJConnect BLE device or enter its Bluetooth address.

error.repair_pairing_failed: Re-pairing failed. Check that the DJConnect device is reachable and showing a pairing code.
error.central_api_url_invalid: Enter a complete HTTPS DJConnect API URL.
error.install_token_invalid: Enter a DJConnect install token that starts with djci_.

error.music_assistant_unavailable: Music Assistant is not installed or configured in Home Assistant.
